user_story: As a guest, I want booking creation to fail if any required field is missing so that incomplete bookings are not saved.

positive.title: Successfully create a booking with all required fields filled
steps: Navigate to the booking creation page.
Fill in all required fields with valid data.
positive.expected_result: The booking is created successfully and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Fail to create a booking when a required field is missing
steps: Navigate to the booking creation page.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the required field is missing and the booking is not created.

edge.title: Attempt to create a booking with invalid data in a required field
steps: Navigate to the booking creation page.
Fill in all required fields with valid data except for one field filled with invalid data (e.g., a string instead of a number).
edge.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that the data in the required field is invalid and the booking is not created.
